changelog: IMPORTANT — Before updating: this release changes the entire project. Back up your vGo database before clicking Update. Fresh installs are supported. For v6.x announcements, join https://t.me/vgocms
Admin UI: full redesign with 14 new admin themes to choose from; your selection is saved in the database
Performance: system-wide speed improvements; entire vGocms codebase restructured for a leaner, more optimized architecture
Security: new protection mechanisms for the admin panel and site APIs
Notifications: fixed user notification delivery; notifications are now limited to new movies, new episodes, or episode edits only
System menu: manage and sync Cloudflare and Google Search Console from one place
Cloudflare: add domains, edit DNS records, purge cache, update security settings, and more
Google Search Console: real search statistics from Google charts, sitemap management, remote sitemap analysis, and more
Overview: brand-new dashboard with detailed system stats, Search Console insights, and security assessments
Security: project-wide security model overhauled
Backend User: updated for vGocms 6.0.0 compatibility
Backend User: pre-save movie validation before writing to the system; faster user processing
100+ user-reported fixes and patches from earlier releases

Site admin / Homepage taxonomy: drag-and-drop reordering for homepage section rows (grip handle); a clear insertion line shows whether the row will land above or below the target; order is persisted when you save and is reflected in GET /api/sites/:slug/home-taxonomy-rows
Themes: optimized and improved theme installation and update flows in the admin UI

Site delete: fixed orphan data left behind when deleting a site — now properly removes SEO configs, SEO translations, taxonomy translations, menus, menu items, menu translations, and all AI job/task queues (SEO, taxonomy, menu)

Site duplication: fixed Error 1062 (duplicate key) on site_videos during clone — orphan rows from a previously failed clone with a recycled site ID are now cleared before batch insert; batch inserts use INSERT IGNORE as a second safety layer
Site duplication / creation: slug conflict now returns HTTP 409 Conflict instead of 500 Internal Server Error when two concurrent requests race for the same slug

Site duplication: resolved duplicate-key races with auto-sync, clearer cloning of site videos and translations, and correct per-site video counts on the admin sites list (removed faulty Redis snapshot)
Site duplication: avoid duplicate key errors on site_videos when the source had overlapping rows; batch inserts for large catalogs
Minor fixes and stability tweaks
Admin: duplicate an existing site from the sites list with a new API slug; copies videos, menus, SEO, ads, filters, and related settings
Duplicate skips theme install/deploy fields and AI or translation job queues; configure theme separately on the new site
Same license rules as creating a site (e.g. Free tier still one site total)
Themes: theme store and updates now work with the online catalog for a simpler install and refresh experience
Admin: installed themes show clearer notices when a newer version is available
Fixes: resolved outstanding issues reported by users
Languages: updated Thai language translations
Videos: added manual sync option for selected videos (arbitrary quantity)
Added related movies section, with suggestions for related titles sharing the same TMDB or IMDB ID
Added AI option to rewrite video content using custom filters
Can now select multiple AI scripts for videos to generate different writing styles
Fixed language editing for videos
File Manager: fixed API route resolution when the admin path is customized, ensuring all file operations continue to work with non-default admin prefixes
Admin UI: delivered a refined visual refresh with targeted CSS enhancements for cleaner layout, improved spacing, and more consistent styling across management pages
Update workflow: improved the system update pipeline to support theme-only updates from update URLs and provide a smoother, more reliable installation experience

Themes: advanced env JSON stays in sync with both .env.local and .env.production.local; values are merged from template defaults, package/ZIP, database, manual file edits, and the admin UI with a clear priority
Themes: install, catalog/embedded update, ZIP update, rebuild, and save-env paths import disk .env where needed and persist merged env JSON to the database
Themes API: ZIP theme update endpoint returns clearer errors when the site has no theme yet or uses a different catalog theme (install from the wizard instead of the update action)
Ophim: do not persist poster or backdrop URLs when no image is available
Menus: renaming a menu item now updates its slug to stay in sync
Crawler: TMDB duplicate checks now cover both movies and TV series so the correct title can be created when the same ID exists only in the other type
Admin: admin interface and layout improvements
Crawler: raise concurrent movie crawl/import limit to 50,000 titles at once
Admin: sidebar and menu layout tuned for clearer navigation and display
Admin: quick AI video create — classification and content-style options in step 1; AI draft uses selected taxonomy and style
AI draft API: accepts taxonomy IDs and ai_style for better titles, SEO, and tags
Quick-create UI: clearer active states in dark mode for stepper and style buttons
Adult (18+) draft prompts tuned for explicit adult-catalog metadata
Add movie showtime schedule
Add movie notifications
Upgrade security features for the admin panel
Add customizable presentation for home page taxonomy sections
Video model: TMDBVoteAverage and IMDBVoteAverage fields
Crawlers: map TMDB vote_average on TMDB, Ophim (TMDB enrich), Anisrc, and Vgo sync paths
TMDB re-crawl updates vote scores on existing videos; optional IMDB id fill from TMDB when missing
Safer updates: avoid wiping IMDB id or TMDB score with empty/zero payloads where applicable
Scan API: raise max page range to 5000
Site API: updates and optimizations
Theme optimizations
Additional new features
Fixes for reported issues
Site API: optimizations
Themes: SEO optimizations and improvements
Themes (catalog): update an installed catalog theme from the admin when a newer package is available, with clearer progress while the update runs
Themes (your ZIP): upload a new ZIP to refresh the site theme without losing saved settings; we stopped showing a misleading “update available” flag tied to files normal admins cannot edit
Themes: the installed-sites list includes a quick way to open the ZIP refresh flow for sites you installed from a ZIP

Themes (wizard): on the last step, only “Install & build” appears for a first install; after a successful install, maintenance actions show up and the install button is hidden for simpler day-to-day use
Miscellaneous fixes from recent user feedback on themes and installation
Fixed regressions from the v2.0.4 patch
Added tag sitemaps (paginated sitemap-tag URLs and backend/API support)
Improved AI handling for language translation
Homepage (Extended): configure sections by taxonomy on the Home tab — section title, see more link, video limit, sort; section translations via modal
Public API: GET /api/sites/:slug/home-taxonomy-rows.
Admin: homepage API documentation in site form + file docs/site-home-taxonomy-api.md
Admin: menu search palette (Ctrl+Q) — find and open admin pages quickly
Admin: palette opens the right page in workspace tabs (embed) or full page in classic mode
Admin: fix palette item clicks (hover no longer blocked navigation)
Admin: video form save in workspace keeps embed view — no double layout inside the iframe
Admin: bottom-right dock — switch tab vs classic mode, scroll to top/bottom
Admin: Fix a few UI issues with the new workspace mode
Theme install: fix npm build on production servers
Admin: fix sites page script when there are no sites yet
Admin: fix menu delete/rename in sidebar (site + global menu manager)
Admin workspace: Dashboard link works when already on the workspace page
Theme: automatic theme installation from admin panel (download, configure, and run theme)
System: fixed remaining issues from version 1.x
Admin workspace: added tab navigation bar — open multiple internal pages, drag to rearrange, close tabs
Crawler: fix 'cannot unmarshal array into Go struct field OphimTaxonomy.id' error by handling dynamic taxonomy ID types (string/array) from Ophim API
Backup: implement automated data backup and S3 storage support
Anisrc crawler: upgrade data collection, support 'Việt Sub/Thuyết Minh' server classification and Kind customization
System: optimize SEO sitemap and fix user-reported issues

Crawler: fix MySQL FK error fk_videos_kind (Error 1452) when inserting videos — correct Ophim type→kind mapping (single/movie → Movie, tv/series/tvshows → Series, hoathinh → Hoạt Hình) and align TMDB/MacCMS/Anisrc kind slugs
Crawler: harden GetOrCreateTaxonomy to avoid invalid kind_id on unique/race conflicts; fallback kind_id null or 0 to taxonomy kind movie before save
Sync pipeline: add taxonomy exclusion filters (category, country, kind) for Site settings and apply them to both manual "Sync Videos" and Auto Sync
Site Videos UX: upgrade sync confirmation to a rich modal with translated filter details, replacing browser confirm dialog
Admin UI: add Simplified Chinese (zh) language pack — active.zh.json + pages_extended.zh.json embedded in backend-ui
Admin language switcher: EN / ZH / VI on header, login, and 2FA pages; ?lang=zh and session admin_locale supported (cn alias → zh)
Add full Anisrc crawler flow: dedicated admin page, scan/search by range, and direct start crawl from compact job list
Enable dynamic Anisrc source management via crawl_sources (add/edit/delete) and auto-seed default source https://anisrc.top on first SQL initialization
Improve Anisrc episode parsing to support pipe format (ep|url), preserve canonical anisrc episode links, and normalize malformed wrappers
Fix Anisrc episode URL normalization to reject external hosts (e.g. ssplay), prefer anisrc paths, and remove trailing .html suffix
Extend Auto Crawler Anisrc options with TMDB preference + language controls while keeping Anisrc/Ophim matching by slug and TMDB/VidSrc by tmdb_id
Add VidSrc integration to Auto Crawler with dedicated source, feed selection (Latest Movies/TV Shows), and TMDB language controls
Improve Auto Crawler controls: allow saving job settings while running and strengthen stop behavior with runtime cancel + Redis stop flag
Refine VidSrc workflow in Auto Crawler: source auto-detection from configured VidSrc domains and stable source synchronization
Enhance Update page usability by adding pagination for long release history
Add new VidSrc Crawl menu for fast bulk workflows (range scan, compact job list, and direct import actions)
Fix VidSrc Crawl page loading issue by registering crawler_vidsrc template in backend template loader
Improve VidSrc latest import: fill missing movie/TV thumb with poster fallback when backdrop is unavailable
Fix VidSrc latest episodes: fetch TMDB still image per episode and update missing episode thumbnails
Update Ophim type-to-kind mapping: hoathinh -> Hoạt Hình, tvshows -> Tvshows, single -> Phim lẻ
Extended License: Multi-language support (site languages, translations for menus, taxonomies, SEO, and video content)
Redis Cache Management: Improved admin tools for cache keys, TTL inspection, and safer flush workflows
Extended License: Copyright-focused theme with full multi-language compatibility
License Management: New interface to manage, update and view license type directly from Update page
Fix VGo Share License: Implement caching for license validation to prevent rate-limiting
Optimize Dashboard Performance: Increase Overview cache TTL to 10 minutes
Refactor View Logic: Use Vietnam timezone (GMT+7) consistently for day/week/month calculations
Optimize AI SEO Generator: Add Incremental Update & Auto-save feature
Improve AI reliability: Generate SEO per page type to handle errors gracefully
Fix OpenRouter Service missing import and add detailed error logging
Update AI Model to z-ai/glm-5 for better SEO output quality
Upgrade to Enterprise-grade Security
Mitigate Cache Poisoning vulnerabilities and prevent DDoS attacks on Movie List API
Optimize Performance & Fix OOM (Out of Memory) issues

Integrate Video Filters for taxonomy pages (Genre, Country, etc.)
Automatically toggle Advanced Filters when active criteria are present
Fix auto-selection issue for filters on taxonomy pages
